description: The banner table every insights team ships - inside Power BI. Questions as blocks, segments as columns, column % with A/B/C letters where a cell is significantly higher. Sticky headers, base row, heat shading; virtualized, so a 30,000-row banner scrolls like a native table and keeps your place across cross-filters. Free forever - and never blocked The table: column % or values (or both), decimals, Total column, base row, heat shading by share, 5 themes, tooltips, cross-filtering by cell. No lock-out, ever. Unlicensed viewers always see the full free tier - no watermark, no broken visual. Premium: the inference (per-user license) Significance letters: column proportion z-tests between banner columns, 90 / 95 / 99 % confidence, optional Bonferroni; low bases flagged with * and excluded - never a fabricated significance. Weighted cells: map Sum of Weight and Sum of Weight2 for Kish effective bases, the SPSS-style convention. Net and mean rows: top / bottom box nets (1-3 points) and mean rows with Welch-test letters, per question block. Try before you buy: every premium feature previews free in edit mode. Licenses are per user, purchased on AppSource and assigned in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Part of the SmartVisuals Research suite - the same engine also powers SmartVisuals Likert, SmartVisuals NPS and the all-in-one SmartVisuals Research visual. Built properly Fully offline,…
